title: Muchak - The Desert Of The Real (Original Mix)

lines.l: When you think about it, in your visual landscape with animals, you see them for months, years, and plants, so you have a familiarity factor with mushrooms that come up and disappear in four or five days.
Some of them can feed you, some can kill you, some can heal you, some of you are scared from your head.
Can kill you, some can heal you.
Some inside you are a spear for driving.
